title: B.Tech Eligibility and Admission Procedure
content:
Official B.Tech Admission Details from DAVIET:

• Duration: 4 Years (8 Semesters)
• Eligibility (1st Year Direct Admission):
  - Passed 10+2 from a recognized board with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, Technical Vocational Subject, Computer Science, IT, Information Practices, Agriculture, Engineering Graphics, or Business Studies.
  - Obtained at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category) in the above subjects taken together.
  - OR Passed Diploma examination in Engineering & Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category).
• Selection Basis:
  - Admission is made on the basis of rank in JEE (Main).
  - Quota distribution: 85% seats reserved for Punjab state candidates, 15% open for outside state (All India) candidates.

• B.Tech Lateral Entry (LEET — Direct 2nd Year / 3rd Semester):
  - Duration: 3 Years
  - Eligibility: Passed Diploma examination with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category) in ANY branch of Engineering/Technology; OR passed B.Sc. degree with at least 45% (40% reserved) with 10+2 Mathematics.
  - Selection: Made on inter-se-merit of the qualifying examination.

Official enquiry portal: https://davietjal.org/enquiry/ | Email: admission@davietjal.org

title: Management, Computer Applications and Allied Programmes Admission
content:
Official Under-Graduate and Post-Graduate Non-Engineering Admissions at DAVIET:

• Programmes Offered:
  - MBA (Master of Business Administration) — 2 Years
  - MCA (Master of Computer Applications — Direct & Lateral Entry) — 2 Years
  - BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) — 3 Years
  - BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) — 3 Years
  - B.Com (Honours) — 3 Years
  - BHMCT (Bachelor of Hotel Management & Catering Technology) — 4 Years
  - BTTM (Bachelor of Tourism & Travel Management) — 4 Years

• Eligibility Guidelines:
  - For UG (BBA, BCA, B.Com, BHMCT, BTTM): Passed 10+2 in any stream (or specified subjects for BCA/B.Com) from a recognized board with minimum required aggregate.
  - For PG (MBA, MCA): Recognized Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved category candidates) plus relevant entrance/merit criteria.

title: Academic Calendar and Course Starting Dates
content:
Academic Session & Course Starting Dates for DAVIET (Affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University):

• Academic Cycle Overview:
  - Odd Semester (Autumn Session — 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th Semesters): Classes commence annually in July / August.
  - Even Semester (Spring Session — 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th Semesters): Classes commence annually in January.

• New Batch (1st Year) Orientation & Commencement:
  - First-year classes and student induction typically begin in August following centralized university/state counselling rounds.
  - Registration and orientation dates are published on the DAVIET circulars portal: https://davietjal.org/news-circulars/

• Examination & Break Schedules:
  - End Semester Examinations (Odd Semester): November - December
  - Winter Break: Late December - Early January
  - End Semester Examinations (Even Semester): May - June
  - Summer Break / Industrial Training: June - July

For official semester-wise calendar notifications and exact circulars, consult https://davietjal.org/academic-calendar/ or IKG-PTU university portal at https://ptu.ac.in.

title: B.Tech and Academic Fee Structure (IKG-PTU Affiliated)
content:
DAVIET is affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKG-PTU), Jalandhar, and strictly follows the university-approved fee schedule for B.Tech and engineering programs.

Approved Fee Structure for B.Tech (Session 2026-27):
• 1st Year — Semester 1: Rs. 47,900 (Tuition Fee Rs. 30,000, Development Fund Rs. 4,000, University Related Fees/URF Rs. 1,150, Student Related Fees/SRF Rs. 2,750, Examination Fee Rs. 2,000, and one-time Admission/Registration/Security deposit Rs. 8,000)
• 1st Year — Semester 2: Rs. 44,300 (Tuition, Development, URF, SRF, and Exam fee)
• Total 1st Year Fee: Rs. 92,200

Subsequent Years (Semesters 3 through 8):
• Semester fee: Rs. 44,300 per semester (approximately Rs. 88,600 per year)

Lateral Entry (LEET — Direct 2nd Year admission):
• Semester fee: Rs. 44,300 per semester plus applicable university registration fee

Hostel and Mess Fees:
• Charged separately on a semester basis (approx. Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 35,000 per semester depending on AC/Non-AC accommodation in Sutlej Boys Hostel, Beas Hostel, or Raavi Girls Hostel).

Official references: IKG-PTU Official Fee Notification & DAVIET Admissions.
